contract.note: An unresolved general hallucination problem is an ordinary reading. The contract fairly distinguishes mitigation from a general solution and excludes the uncertain future clause from scoring.

evidence.note: OpenAI's contemporaneous disclosure acknowledges residual GPT-4 hallucinations. It supports the observation but cannot alone establish the field-wide conclusion.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous survey and mitigation research support the historical observation that general hallucination remained unsolved. Reported improvements do not establish elimination. This finding does not score or endorse the uncertain suggestion that a future solution requires a new paradigm.

contract.note: Robust alignment rather than selected benchmark improvements is a fair ordinary reading. A matching impossibility result would suffice for support; continued failures would not.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither an independently validated LLM-only alignment solution nor an impossibility result covering the claimed class. Improvements and failures both fall short of the early-resolution criteria. The firm forecast has no deadline and remains unresolved.

OpenAI reports retaining its workforce through the original crisis, but subsequent condition status remains unknown. The conditional forecast cannot be scored as successful or failed.
